findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 12 in the same format as Chapter 1 (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 78 questions numbered 1-78; by section: 12.1 6, 12.2 7, 12.3 12, 12.4 17, 12.5 10, 12.6 9, 12.7 5, 12.8 3, 12.9 2, 12.10 2, 12.11 3, 12.12 2.

Covers sections 12.1-12.12 in order; comparison questions are answered as two-column tables; small numericals use new values and were recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed (proton uud, pi+ = u anti-d, Z is the atomic number, nucleon number A, Higgs boson not a force carrier); the misprinted percentages of 12.10 and the free-neutron half-life are not used.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
